latest.title: Rectangular Pegs on Jordan Curves of Finite $p$-Variation
latest.abstract: We prove that every planar Jordan curve of finite \(p\)-variation, with \(1\leq p<2\), inscribes a rectangle of every prescribed similarity class. In particular, every such curve inscribes a square. The proof combines the recent criterion of Asano and Ike with a variation-controlled approximation argument. We show that for every \(q>p\), a Jordan curve of finite \(p\)-variation can be approximated in the \(q\)-variation topology by smooth Jordan embeddings. The construction uses simple polygonal interpolants of Boedihardjo and Geng, an elementary interpolation inequality between variation seminorms, and a variation-controlled smoothing of polygonal embeddings. Young integration then gives locally uniform convergence of the associated primitives.
latest.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
latest.workSummary: 证明有限 p-变差且 1≤p<2 的平面 Jordan 曲线内接每个指定相似类的矩形，特别是正方形。
latest.breakthrough: 把内接矩形结论推广到允许较低正则性的曲线类，并建立控制变差的逼近桥梁。
latest.limitations: 不覆盖所有 Jordan 曲线，也不包含 p≥2 的临界及超临界情形。 本条基于已检查来源的阅读分析，关键结论请回查原文。
latest.priorityReason: 经典几何问题的明确范围推进，变差逼近技术具有独立复用价值。
